name: Slack
summary: Preview: receive Slack messages in Girru and keep a log.
description: A first step for Slack in Girru. It receives the messages your Slack app sends to Girru's address, only when Slack signed them with your signing secret, and keeps them in a log you can read. Your agents can log a message for a Slack channel, but sending to Slack itself is not built yet: nothing leaves Girru. It does not answer messages by itself.
permissions: Opens one public address (/api/ext/slack/webhook) that accepts only requests Slack signed with your signing secret
Keeps the Slack settings you save; the tokens are never sent back to the page
Keeps the messages it receives and logs in its own tables
Sends nothing to Slack or anywhere else yet
Adds a slack_send tool (it logs only) that agents can use once you allow them
